speaker: john_shakespeare
text: My son the Queen's servant, come home by the Queen's highway like one of the Queen's beggars. Did they take your horse for debt? It runs in the blood.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The horse was dear, sir.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Nine were set. The tenth is under thy hands.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Hamnet Sadler sent the loaf up. He says it is the size the assize allows.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: It is a fish day. The loaf is the new wheat. That is the feast on the board.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: The rye is in, and it is light.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: The rye is in, and I helped to turn it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The wheat at Shottery stands thin. Thin beside what?

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Beside a good year. The barley can wait.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: The barley can wait. Not a figure. Not at this table. Not before the children.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: The weather will hold.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: There is fish, and not much of it. The loaf will go further.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thy mother put the heel on thy trencher. Eat it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating the heel. I am not pricing a field.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Light, on the rye. Say light, so I know thou hast heard thy brother.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Light. I have it, sir.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The wheat at Shottery stands thin. Once is enough.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Pass the loaf. The heel stays where she put it.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: I have said my say about the highway. I am for the rye.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then the rye. In, and light. Thou hast walked into the harvest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The rye in, and light. The wheat thin. No barley from me.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Keep it so. A figure would turn the board into a market.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The loaf is the size he sent. Let it be that size.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The basin is after we have eaten. Not in the middle of the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After, then.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Richard has given us the weather. I will take it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Eat.
